reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering iron resources and fencing, minerals, a seasonal decoration, Jazz seeds, and jelly were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover material terminology, mineral names, object gender, gameplay percentages, seasonal planting instructions, the flavored-item placeholder, and approved glossary terminology; both found no remaining objective issue.

IronFence_Description.source: Lasts longer than a stone fence.
IronFence_Description.translation: Rezistă mai mult decât un gard de piatră.

IronOre_Description.source: A fairly common ore that can be smelted into bars.
IronOre_Description.translation: Un minereu destul de comun, care poate fi topit în lingouri.

IronStone_Description.source: Break apart to obtain iron ore.
IronStone_Description.translation: Sparge-o pentru a obține minereu de fier.

Jade_Description.translation: O piatră ornamentală de culoare verde-pal.

Jagoite_Description.source: A high volume of tiny crystals makes it very glittery.
Jagoite_Description.translation: Numărul mare de cristale minuscule îl face foarte sclipitor.

Jamborite_Description.source: The crystals are so tightly packed it almost looks fuzzy.
Jamborite_Description.translation: Cristalele sunt atât de înghesuite, încât aproape pare pufos.

Jasper_Description.source: When polished, this stone becomes attractively luminous. Prized by ancient peoples for thousands of years.
Jasper_Description.translation: După lustruire, această piatră capătă o strălucire atrăgătoare. A fost prețuită de popoarele antice timp de mii de ani.

JazzSeeds_Description.source: Plant in spring. Takes 7 days to produce a blue puffball flower.
JazzSeeds_Description.translation: Plantează-le primăvara. Au nevoie de 7 zile pentru a produce o floare albastră și pufoasă.
